name: When is the best time of year to start a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to start a home remodel often depends on the specific project and local climate. In Southern California, many homeowners prefer to begin projects that involve exterior work, such as additions or roofing, during the drier, milder months of spring or fall to avoid potential rain delays. Interior-only projects have more flexibility, but scheduling during off-peak contractor seasons can sometimes lead to better availability. Discuss your project and timeline preferences with your contractor for optimal planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: For exterior work in Southern California, spring or fall are often preferred due to milder weather. Interior projects have more flexibility.
